title: Frame Chains and Relative Pose
hints: Write every transform as T_<to>_<from> and make adjacent subscripts cancel: T_c_l = T_c_w · T_w_r · T_r_l.
T_c_w is T_w_c.inverse(). `Eigen::Isometry3d::inverse()` is cheap (it uses the transpose).
Relative pose: T_a_b = T_a_w · T_w_b = T_w_a⁻¹ · T_w_b. Prediction: T_w_b = T_w_a · T_a_b.
